items.definition:
A hormone and neurotransmitter (adrenaline).
Epinephrine is used to treat severe allergic reactions.

Sexual intercourse between unmarried people.
Some religions consider fornication a sin.

a sexually transmitted bacterial infection
Gonorrhea is a treatable sexually transmitted infection.

any of a group of basic proteins found in chromatin
Histones play a crucial role in DNA packaging.

a single type specimen upon which the description and name of a new species is based
The holotype of the new insect species is preserved in the museum.

failure of the immune system to protect the body from infection
Patients with immunodeficiency are more susceptible to infections.

a medical condition with yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes
Newborn babies sometimes develop mild jaundice.

a printing process
The artist used lithography to create the intricate print.

a rich vein of ore; a rich supply
The miners discovered a rich lode of gold in the mountain.

a small quantity of a particular thing
He only showed a modicum of interest in the proposal.

a person who is hostile or indifferent to culture and the arts, or who has no understanding of them
He was dismissed as a philistine for his lack of appreciation for classical music.

a small growth, typically benign and with a stalk, protruding from a mucous membrane
The doctor found a small polyp during the colonoscopy.

a late-20th-century style and concept in the arts, architecture, and criticism
The lecture explored the key tenets of postmodernism in literature.

the practice of having casual sex frequently with different partners
The novel explored themes of freedom and promiscuity in the 1920s.

a sense of disgust and loathing
She felt a deep sense of revulsion at the sight.

a point of no return
By signing the contract, he crossed the Rubicon.

a person of profound learning
He was a musical savant, able to play complex pieces by ear.

a view or scene
The artist captured the urban scape beautifully.

the ability to pay one's debts
The company's solvency was in question after the losses.

the gradual caving in or sinking of an area of land
The house was damaged by ground subsidence.

a male reproductive gland
The testis produces sperm and hormones.

Cunning tricks used to deceive or manipulate.
He used his wiles to persuade her.

A small edible sea snail.
We collected winkles from the rocks at low tide.

A man holding and cultivating a small landed estate; a freeholder.
The yeoman farmer worked his land diligently.

Christmas or the Christmas season.
We gathered around the fire during the Yule season.

A device that stores energy; a battery.
The car's accumulator needed to be recharged.

hostility or ill feeling
He felt a strong animus towards his former business partner.

a deep-seated feeling of dislike; aversion
Her antipathy towards modern art was well-known.

a senior Christian cleric
The archdeacon presided over the church council meeting.

a compound of bromine with another element or radical; a trite and unoriginal statement
His speech was full of old bromides about hard work and success.

A person who writes accounts of important or historical events.
The chronicler meticulously recorded the events of the war.

An official announcement or statement, especially to the media.
The government issued a communique regarding the peace talks.

Evidence that confirms or supports a statement, theory, or finding.
The witness's testimony provided strong corroboration for the prosecution's case.

An inhabitant or occupant of a particular place.
The denizens of the forest included deer and bears.

A member of a class of cavalry regiments in several European armies.
The king's dragoons were known for their bravery.

Great happiness and exhilaration.
She felt a surge of elation when she won the competition.

the act of excluding someone from a religious community
The bishop threatened him with excommunication for his heresy.

a structure designed to reduce drag
The motorcycle's fairing helps improve its aerodynamics.

a hieroglyphic character or symbol
Ancient Mayan glyphs tell stories of their civilization.

a tough, uncompromising man
He was known as a hardman on the football pitch, never backing down from a tackle.

the development of industries in a country or region
The industrialisation of the country led to significant economic growth.

lack of skill or ability
His ineptitude at managing the project was evident to everyone.

A noblewoman ranking above a countess and below a duchess; a type of gem cut.
The marquise wore a stunning diamond necklace.

a scientist who studies the nervous system
The neuroscientist explained how the brain processes information.

a doctor who specializes in eye care
I need to see an ophthalmologist for my eye condition.

the quality of being porous
The porosity of the soil affects its water retention.

the quality of being greater in number, quantity, or importance
There is a preponderance of evidence against the defendant.

the emblems or insignia of royalty, an order, or an office
The king wore his full regalia for the coronation ceremony.

the advocacy or practice of separation of a certain group of people from a larger body on the basis of ethnicity, religion, or gender
The region has a long history of political separatism.

a loud, confused noise, especially one caused by a large mass of people
The city was in a state of tumult after the protests.

the main body of an aircraft
The airframe of the new jet was designed for maximum aerodynamic efficiency.

a scene of uproar and confusion
The classroom was in complete bedlam after the teacher left.

the final and crowning achievement; a finishing stone
The senior project is the capstone of their undergraduate studies.

the process of a liquid changing to a solid or semi-solid state
Blood coagulation is a vital process to stop bleeding.

the act of an animal living or sheltering in a den
Bear denning behavior changes with the seasons.

a decorative detail or feature added to something
The story was full of embellishments to make it more exciting.

the process of making things equal
The equalization of opportunities is a key goal for the government.

a report that reveals something discreditable
The newspaper published a shocking exposé on political corruption.

a widely used herbicide
Concerns have been raised about the environmental impact of glyphosate.

a person with a humpback
The story of the hunchback of Notre Dame is famous.

a chemical functional group consisting of an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom
The hydroxyl group is a key component of alcohols.

the reliance of two or more things on each other
Global economies demonstrate a high degree of interdependence.

an armed uprising of Palestinians against Israeli occupation
The First Intifada began in 1987.

an organic compound containing a carbonyl group
Ketone bodies are produced when the body burns fat for energy.
